tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “¿Viene Pablo a la fiesta?”

B hears the question and builds the answer. Look at the opening words: a fact you state or confirm takes the indicative (creo que viene, es verdad que se va); a denied opinion, a doubt or a possibility takes the subjunctive (no creo que venga, es posible que esté). Put the blue verb in the right form. A tile in brackets, like (él), says who; it is not written.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Finally: swap cards and do it all again, faster.

tandemRedemittel.p2: «Creo que» + indicativo, pero «no creo que» + subjuntivo.
